data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'araf', meaning 'to be high, elevated, exalted'. The name Arfaaz signifies nobility and honor. The name Arfaaz carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arfaaz usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
